title: UAAP: Unbeaten NUNS boys clobber Zobel, book Finals berth
summary: Defending champion National University-Nazareth School completed a perfect elimination-round campaign to clinch an outright finals berth in the UAAP Season 89 High School Boys’ 16-and-under…

blocks.text: Defending champion National University-Nazareth School completed a perfect elimination-round campaign to clinch an outright finals berth in the UAAP Season 89 High School Boys’ 16-and-under basketball tournament after routing De La Salle Zobel, 86-56, on Tuesday at the DLSZ Sports Pavilion.
